entry.title: [Magick.NET-Q8-x86] ImageMagick: Heap Buffer Over-Write of a single byte in the JP2 encoder.
entry.content:
An incorrect check in the JP2 will result in an heap buffer over-write of a single byte when specifying certain options.

References

  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/security/advisories/GHSA-533m-3wf6-c33v
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-533m-3wf6-c33v

entry.title: [Magick.NET-Q8-x86] ImageMagick: Stack overflow in fx operation
entry.content:
Due to a missing depth check a stack overflow can occur in the fx operation by passing a crafted argument.

References

  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/security/advisories/GHSA-rcr6-g7jc-f57g
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-rcr6-g7jc-f57g
